verses.text: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
lines: I waited patiently for Yahweh.
He turned to me, and heard my cry.

verses.text: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
lines: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit,
out of the miry clay.
He set my feet on a rock,
and gave me a firm place to stand.

verses.text: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
lines: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God.
Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.

verses.text: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
lines: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust,
and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

verses.text: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
lines: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done,
and your thoughts which are toward us.
They can’t be declared back to you.
If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

verses.text: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
lines: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire.
You have opened my ears.
You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

verses.text: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
lines: Then I said, “Behold, I have come.
It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

verses.text: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
lines: I delight to do your will, my God.
Yes, your law is within my heart.”

verses.text: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.
lines: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly.
Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.

verses.text: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
lines: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart.
I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation.
I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

verses.text: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
lines: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh.
Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

verses.text: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
lines: For innumerable evils have surrounded me.
My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up.
They are more than the hairs of my head.
My heart has failed me.

verses.text: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
lines: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me.
Hurry to help me, Yahweh.

verses.text: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
lines: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it.
Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

verses.text: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
lines: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

verses.text: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”
lines: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you.
Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”

verses.text: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
lines: But I am poor and needy.
May the Lord think about me.
You are my help and my deliverer.
Don’t delay, my God.
